tieu_de: Jupiter transit through the 11th house: friends, groups and future plans
mo: Why do my goals keep changing during this transit?
Is this a good time to start a group project or community initiative?
Can friends really change my career?

Your address book matters more than usual when Y Jupiter passes through the 11th house. This is the part of the chart that covers friends, networks, communities and the hopes you hold for the years ahead. For about a year, the people you meet and the groups you join can quietly redirect where you are going.
After the career push of the 10th house, this transit feels more social and less pressured. Success turns into connection. You find your people, and they help you see what you want next.

doan: The 11th house is about belonging to something larger than yourself: a circle of friends, a professional association, a cause, an online community. It also holds your long-range goals, the picture of the future you are working toward.

Jupiter expands both. Your social world grows, and the new faces bring ideas that make you revise your plans. It is common to end this year with goals that look different from the ones you started with, usually in a good way.
Planet Jupiter Rules Sagittarius Expansion, knowledge, luck

You are invited into a new group or asked to join a board or committee. A friend introduces you to someone who becomes important to your work. Your social calendar fills with gatherings, meetups and events. You reconnect with old friends and make new ones who share your interests.

Some people take on a leadership role in a club, a community project or a nonprofit. Others find their online presence grows and they connect with people far beyond their usual circle. Group projects, team efforts and collaborations tend to go well.

Networks built now tend to pay off in unexpected ways. A casual friendship can lead to a job, a partnership or an idea that changes your direction. People are more willing to help you, and you are more willing to help them.
This is also a good year to rethink your goals. The new people around you show you options you had not considered. If your old plans no longer excite you, let this transit help you draw up new ones.
It is easy to overcommit socially. Every invitation sounds fun, every group sounds worthwhile, and soon your evenings are gone. Some friendships formed now may be wide rather than deep.
There is also a risk of following the crowd. When a group is enthusiastic about something, Jupiter makes it easy to get swept along. Check whether the group's goals are really yours.

Jupiter spends about a year in each sign and a similar length in each house. Your 11th house could be larger or smaller depending on the house system and the latitude of your birth, so the transit may be shorter or longer. Contacts Jupiter makes to natal planets in the house usually mark the busiest points.
Join one group that matches the future you want, whether professional, creative or community based, and show up regularly.
Reach out to friends you have lost touch with. Many useful connections this year come through old ties renewed.
Write down your goals for the next five years, then revise them after a few months of new conversations.
Offer your skills to a cause you care about. Contribution builds the strongest networks.
Keep some evenings free. A full social calendar is not the same as a meaningful one.

Because you are meeting people and ideas that widen your view. The 11th house holds your hopes for the future, and Jupiter stretches them. Let the changes happen, but check they reflect your own wishes and not just the enthusiasm of those around you.
Yes. Collective efforts tend to attract support and goodwill now. Share the load and give credit generously, and the project is likely to outlast the transit.

Often, yes. Many people find that a friend's introduction, recommendation or idea leads to their next role. The 11th house follows the 10th for a reason, since it is where the benefits of career success are shared and multiplied through others.
